answer: The Zenith-based Saffron Hashing mechanism protects against Sybil attacks by utilizing a unique, agent-identifiable saffron-colored hash function. Each agent's unique ember-like identifier is hashed with a time-stamped, agent-unique salt, generating a distinct, agent-specific string. As agents interact, their hashes are periodically compared to detect anomalies, effectively preventing fake identities from reaching the zenith of the network, thus safeguarding the integrity of the decentralized economy.
